title: Range of ideal multiplication on module stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $J,F$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\iota:J\to\mathcal O_X$ any linear morphism. Form $\mu:J\otimes F\to F$ as $\iota\otimes1$ followed by the left unitor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For $x\in X$ let $S$ be the module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], with germs [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and let $e:S(\mathcal O_X)\cong\mathcal O_{X,x}$ be a linear isomorphism sending every section germ to its ring germ. Put $I=\operatorname{range}(e\circ S(\iota))$. Then the range of $S(\operatorname{Im}(\mu)\hookrightarrow F)$ is $I\cdot F_x$, the submodule generated by $a m$ for $a\in I$, $m\in F_x$. No monomorphism hypothesis on $\iota$ is required.

image of the multiplication map on stalks of a sheaf of ideals and a sheaf of modules

lean.statement: theorem ideal_multiplication_stalk_range {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : X.Modules} (ι : J ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (F : X.Modules) (x : X) (e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅ ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (he : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (r : Γ(X, U)), e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U x hx r) = X.presheaf.germ U x hx r) : letI : MonoidalCategory X.Modules := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf let S := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x LinearMap.range (S.map (image.ι (ι ▷ F ≫ (λ_ F).hom))).hom = (LinearMap.range (S.map ι ≫ e.hom).hom : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) • (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) (S.obj F))
